summary: Pool Hosts tab: row actions (maintenance, fence device, promotion, master change, eject) move into one Actions menu in a trailing column; the master's row no longer offers actions that can never apply to it; every column but Convergence shrinks to its content; and the empty Add host to pool dialog says the new host must be enrolled first instead of reading as if the pool had no master. API impact: none — the page calls the same pool member, join-candidate and action endpoints with the same payloads.

guide.reason: Enter maintenance moved from the Maintenance column into the row's Actions menu, and the join steps now explain the empty candidate list and the enroll-first step.

api.reason: Presentation only: no request, response, command or report changes; GET /api/v1/pools/{id}/members and /join-candidates are read exactly as before.

roadmap.reason: UI polish inside the existing Phase 4 pool Hosts view.

state.reason: No state is added or moved; the view renders what the pool master and hosts report.

verification.method: npm test and tsc --noEmit in web/; simulated headless Firefox captures of the rendered MembersTable and empty AddHostDialog markup with style.css at 1600 px and 420 px (labelled simulation, not a live Controller walkthrough).
